svg.title: k6 load-test topology
svg.desc: A load-test account separate from the Kustamie account: a t3.medium EC2 manager drives c6i.2xlarge EC2 k6 workers that send HTTP load to Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda in the Kustamie account, for large-scale runs of 5,000 to 60,000 virtual users. A sample k6 summary: http_req_duration avg 9.09 ms, p95 10.8 ms, max 4.09 s; iteration_duration p95 5.01 s but max 16.36 s; 0.00% failed; 30,000 VUs max.
svg.text: p95 looks fine; the max is the long tail.
